notes: Screen reader, quieter where it matters. Fixed: the seek bar and the sleep timer stopped narrating themselves - both used to have TalkBack read the changing position or countdown out loud roughly once or twice a second for as long as focus sat there, not just while you were actually adjusting them; now the seek bar only speaks during a real drag, and the sleep timer counts down by the minute instead of the second. Fixed: the offline banner stopped repeating itself - it used to re-announce "Offline, tap to retry" about once a minute for as long as you were offline, now it says so once, when it actually changes. Fixed: pull-to-refresh stopped announcing itself over everything else on the Radio tab - it had drifted onto a region covering the whole list, so almost any change there could set it off. Fixed: a podcast or track failure is announced once now, not once immediately and then again, worded differently, the next time you opened Radio or Settings. Fixed: Sound Zone's dynamic range reading stopped narrating every second it was on screen. Fixed: opening or leaving Sound Zone no longer drops TalkBack focus somewhere unexpected - it returns to the row you tapped. Fixed: expanding a Settings section is instant for TalkBack instead of waiting out a scroll animation that has nothing to show a screen reader. Podcasts. Fixed: "No results" now offers Retry even when you're not offline, so one flaky search source doesn't look like the podcast doesn't exist. Steadier underneath. Fixed a couple of loading-state race conditions in Pravah's channel, playlist and comments screens, where a superseded request could get stuck showing a spinner for content that already finished loading. Radio and TV's own background freshness checks no longer needlessly wait on each other either.
